# Long use case fixture (~15K+ chars)

## Section 1: Detailed domain module 1

### Business context
This module addresses operational scenario 1 for enterprise users who manage complex multi-step processes across departments. Stakeholders expect full traceability, role-based access, and integration with existing systems.

### Personas (1)
- Executive sponsor 1: Approves budgets and reviews KPI dashboards weekly
- Operations manager 1: Configures workflows and assigns tasks daily
- Field agent 1: Executes tasks on mobile with offline sync
- Compliance reviewer 1: Audits actions monthly

### Functional requirements
- REQ-0001-01: Authenticated users shall access module 1 per RBAC matrix v1
- REQ-0001-02: System shall record immutable audit events for all mutations in module 1
- REQ-0001-03: Batch import shall accept up to 10,000 rows for entity batch 1
- REQ-0001-04: Notifications shall fire within 30 seconds of trigger event 1
- REQ-0001-05: Search shall support fuzzy match across fields set 1

### Non-functional requirements
- P95 latency under 800ms for read operations in module 1
- 99.9% availability during business hours for region 1

### User journey (happy path)
1. User opens module 1 dashboard
2. User filters dataset 1 by date and status
3. User selects records and applies action 1
4. System validates and commits with confirmation
5. User downloads summary report for module 1
